reviews.text: Amazing first experience at Nest Grooming Studio! They took a detailed initial briefing and genuinely cared about my dog Mitch, a senior Akita. They did proper grooming for his double coat and let him rest in between since he's an older dog. They explained the plan and what to expect up front, and texted a specific finish time 30 minutes before pickup. Mitch was the happiest I've ever seen him after a grooming session — giving kisses to everyone and looking years younger! We got a detailed debrief and made plans for the next appointment. Pricing is reasonable. Highly recommend!

Our pup Stella has always been terrified of the groomer but that changed after coming to Nest a couple of times. The studio and Phil have a great calming energy and she's in such a good mood when we pick her up. Highly recommend this place!

I just took my Shih Tzu puppy for his first groom this past weekend, and it was such a great experience from beginning to end. We did a short consultation where we were walked through the entire process, and any questions we had were thoughtfully answered. I was a little nervous about his first experience grooming, wanting to make sure that it was a positive experience for him - but any concerns I had vanished after our consultation. Communication about the process and our pick-up time was very clear and made the whole thing seamless. Our dog not only looked great, but as part of the Nest promotions in August, they took his portrait, which is something Nest does periodically throughout the year during certain months for appointments on the weekend. It was a great keepsake to mark his first groom and it's great to have his picture taken when he's looking his best. I cannot say enough nice things about Nest and the staff and their services. Highly, highly recommend.

I had a wonderful experience with Jasper Grooming. They explained everything clearly and took the time to answer all my questions as a dog owner. Their patience, professionalism, and genuine care made me feel comfortable and confident. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for excellent and compassionate grooming services.
My cat's first grooming experience was amazing.

The spa is very clean, modern, and calming. Phil does a fantastic job and always takes the time to play with my puppy beforehand, helping him feel comfortable and building a genuine bond with him. You can really see how much he cares about the dogs and the quality of his work. A truly high end dog spa with excellent service and attention to detail. Highly recommend.

Absolutely love taking our mini poodle Dino here. Phil is incredible with him
And always takes the time to make him feel comfortable, plays with him, and makes grooming a positive experience🐶✨ And of course, he always does an amazing job grooming him! You can truly tell they  genuinely love animals and take pride in what they do. Highly recommend!

Our Westie pup, Archie, is always so excited to go! The puppy introduction program definitely helped with making him used to being groomed and he loves to see Phil and Annie. They know their breed standards for grooming and after his sessions everyone always asks how he is so handsome! The answer is Nest!

I’ve been coming to Nest Grooming Studio several times now, and I’ve always been very happy with their service. They are professional, friendly, and really know how to groom Toy Poodles. If you’re looking for a nice, clean, and well-shaped Toy Poodle haircut, I highly recommend this place. They always do a great job!

Highly recommend Nest Grooming! After our puppy had a negative experience with another groomer, we were so happy to find this studio. The space is calm and inviting, but more importantly Phil's approach is amazing. He takes the time to know your dog and let him get comfortable. Our little guy looked and smelled great afterwards and when we went to pick him up he was falling asleep in Phil's lap :)
Moved into the area and started just googling groomers and stumbled upon this amazing spot!! Great service, the cuts themselves are great, nice aesthetic and very happy with it all. Look at my boy

We found the perfect spot to take Stanley to get a kind and efficient grooming service.
I highly recommend it as the best place comparing with the past services we tried.
This is the best groomer and you will not regret it!!!! they take care of your fur baby like their own. very safe environment and very soothing. I would 1000 percent recommend this place 😀

When your 5 month old puppy needs his first full groom, you want to make sure he has a great experience.  I found Nest Grooming Studio on google and instagram, and after reading the fantastic reviews, I decided to give them a try.  I am so glad I did!  Everything about the visit was fantastic.  The appointment started with a 30 minute free consult where Phil explained the different grooming options and he also advised what the best cut would be for our mini sheepadoodle pup, Charlie. The atmosphere in Nest is so calm and inviting and we felt at ease leaving Charlie in such good hands.   Thank you for making Charlie’s first full groom such a wonderful experience for him & for us. We will definitely be back & I highly recommend Nest to anyone in the Toronto area searching for a good groomer.

A wonderful experience for our senior dog.  The environment is spa-like and much nicer than any other grooming place we have been.

One note that it is on the second floor with a steep set of stairs. Phil was lovely and carried our doodle up. Just something to be aware of if your dog can't do stairs.

You can tell they definitely care about the animals they groom and do a thorough intake on your first visit.

We will definitely be back.

Finally, I found the perfect groomer who is professional, honest coupled with great skills.  The salon is super clean and Phil is always pleasant and friendly.  Westie owners know how challenging it is to find someone who can do a proper Westie cut.  A very happy customer + doggo 😊 …

Willow’s third visit at Nest Grooming Studio, and once again we are so happy with the results. Phil and Annie always take the time to talk with us and go through everything before the grooming session starts. Even when Willow has some matted hair, they are patient and gentle, taking the time to brush her properly.

This time we asked for a shorter haircut since the weather is getting warmer. Even though she had some matting, they really listened to our request not to shave her. We had a bad experience with another groomer in the past who didn’t listen at all, so this meant a lot to us.

We truly appreciate the care, attention, and respect they show every visit. We couldn’t recommend them enough.

Amazing excellent service!!!! Nice calm ambiance and I would highly recommend this place
They are very great with our fur babies
Raiting of this spa is 5 stars!!!!⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ we love the fact that all fur babies are very calm there and not stressed at all and that you can tell that they are very loving to fur babies 🥰
Phil was amazing with our Griffin Larry who is a bit anxious and very vocal. He did a wonderful job, he looks like a show dog!!  So glad we found Nest.
Very thoughtful and professional service. Treated my dog great and did a great job. 10/10 would recommend .

Another wonderful experience at Nest Grooming Studio! My dog Teddy was so excited to return which is a wonderful sign- he normally hates going to the groomer! I was so impressed with their quality of care and their customer service… and of course Teddy’s groom. He looks and smells fantastic and I will definitely be taking him back regularly 😊
Phil is a great guy. My puppy has recently been anxious with grooming, but Phil was very friendly and patient with him. Also, the haircut is really cute.

I had not taken my corgi for grooming in six years because of her intense fear and I was so anxious. Within moments, Annie and Phil were calmly on the ground chatting with me and she was rubbing against them. It was the most conscientious, thoughtful, warm, and compassionate business experience I have had. There was no time limit; it was all about my girl’s comfort. She came out in Phil’s arms, a smile in her face. Plus, she is SO cute in her new cut (corgi bum too!). I cannot recommend Annie and Phil more. Beyond best in the city.

This is the only grooming studio you need. The team at Nest were so kind and attentive to our pup. They went through everything they were gonna be doing during the groom session and our boy didn’t even want to leave afterwards! He came out smiling, looking handsome as all heck, and smelling fresh. Many thanks to Nest!

There’s no better name to define Nest Grooming studio as NEST! Such a warming place where your pup goes for a grooming service (the best in town!) and feels welcomed by such a special team! I cannot recommend Nest enough for Toronto pups!
Thank you for the wonderful grooming experience! Our dogs enjoyed every minute...The studio is clean, calming and welcoming. We will definitely be back again soon!
Took my dog here for a groom and they did the most amazing job! He looks and smells amazing. We will be back!

We had a great first visit to Nest after some not so pleasant experiences elsewhere. I appreciate the time they spent getting to know me and my puppy before and asking questions about what grooming style we wanted for our dog. They also took us through every process step-by-step which is a first for me. It made me feel much more comfortable leaving my puppy for 2-3 hours.

The space itself is extremely clean, calm and spa-like. The outdoor terrace for the dogs is an added bonus.
Highly recommend this grooming studio. We’ll be back in 5 weeks!

Such an amazing experience at Nest grooming, for both myself and my puppy. We started with the puppy package (includes 3 visits) and they were so caring and patient with him to make sure he had a positive and happy experience. Whenever I picked him up he always seemed very calm and well taken care of. I love how they take the time to plan how you would like the grooming to go and always pay attention to detail and preferences. I also really appreciate the time they take to focus on usually only having one dog at a time in the studio. All in all an amazing customer experience for both the human and the pet! So happy I found this place!

We had a great experience with Nest Grooming Studio. The onboarding process was very well organized and thoughtful. They took the time to understand our dog, ask the right questions, and make sure everyone was comfortable before getting started

So happy to have found Nest.  We had stopped going to groomers as our dog was very scared upon arrival each time.  Nest's no kennel and constant care approach made all the difference for our dog. Beautiful grooming work and nail/paw care as well.  Thank you so much!  Highly recommend!

After moving to the city, I was looking for a dog groomer and couldn’t have asked for a better experience than Nest Grooming. The staff were so friendly, the space felt cozy and welcoming, and my pup’s grooming completely exceeded my expectations.

My dog had a lot of matting and I was prepared for a full shave, but Nest Grooming worked their magic and treated my pup with so much care and love. It was an amazing experience for both of us.

I’ll definitely be back and would highly recommend them to anyone searching for a groomer, you won’t be disappointed at all.

Since moving to Canada, I’ve been trying to find a groomer I can truly trust — and I finally found one today. It’s a lovely grooming studio that feels just like a home: very clean, cozy, and tastefully decorated. The owner was incredibly kind and patient with my nervous dog, Chips, giving her plenty of time to settle in. She looks amazing after the grooming, and I’m extremely satisfied. We’ll definitely be coming back — highly recommended!

We've been coming to Nest for a few months and have nothing but great things to say. It's a clean and relaxing space. Phil & Annie are always so gentle with our dog who has a lot of anxiety, and clearly took a lot of special care and effort with our most recent groom!!

I could not have been happier with my experience at Nest Grooming Studio. Annie and Phil took such amazing care of my Golden Retriever Teddy. We were welcomed into the studio and guided through the process - everything was explained perfectly. I was so impressed as Phil and Annie took the time to meet Teddy and did everything to make him feel comfortable and at ease in their care.
I was absolutely thrilled with his groom (and the photoshoot was icing on the cake!)
Highly recommended 5/5 stars!

This was our first visit, Phil and Annie took the time the get to know our dog and our past grooming experiences. They clearly explained  the cut they were recommending and asked for input.  We are very happy with the results and will be going back for his next groomings

Paws up for Nest grooming studio! 🐾💫 I had such a great grooming experience—super gentle, no rushing, and lots of care to keep me comfy. They checked every detail to make sure I looked my best, and even sent my mom home with a souvenir picture! 📷🐕🎄✨
Big WOOF thanks to Annie and Phil!

So grateful for Annie and Phil’s unique one to one dog grooming business. My pup is a rescue from S. Korea and was previously homeless - only having been with me for 4 months. Phil was very knowledgable on advising on the groom and taking the time and care getting to know my pup, making sure he was comfortable throughout. It’s my pup’s first time at a professional groomers - it was such a relaxing and non-fearful experience for him. Highly recommend this business and extra star for the portrait experience - my pup looks so handsome and happy! We’ll be back for future grooms

Had the best experience today at Nest Grooming! My dog Rocky can be sensitive around other dogs, and the staff took such great care to make sure he wasn’t overstimulated. When I picked him up, he looked absolutely handsome, and the sweet Christmas photos they took of him were the icing on the cake. I will definitely be coming back and will be recommending them to all my friends. Highly recommend! Thank you so much Nest Grooming.

I am so glad to find this place. Phill was incredible with my little Roxy, she does not really like to get a bath and I left her a little uneasy, as she also tends to be a bit nervous when she's in new places. My sister picked her up and told me that Roxy was completely happy playing with Phil and letting him carry and hug her as if she had known him all her life. I’ll come back for sure. Roxy was so clean and shiny ✨ her nails were really well trim. 100 % recommended.

We just had our second visit to nest —first at 4 months, now again at 7 months

As a puppy, having a positive grooming experience is so important, and I love that they totally get that. They make sure every moment feels safe, calm, and comfortable, which is huge for building good habits and confidence early on!

Highly recommended for anyone looking for groomers who offer more than just a haircut. If you want a place where your pup is treated with kindness, where your requests matter, and where the staff puts your dog’s comfort first, this is the studio to go to.

I recommend to get free consultation + desirable service for your first visit (we did bath & tidy) 🐶

Annie and phil take a really good care of your pupss 🐶

Vesper always enjoys going there, having her best time and getting freshly groomed ✨

Highly, highly recommend for your pups if you care about how your pup gets treated and taken care of 🫶

Took our newly adopted Samoyed there, excellent facility. Very homely, took care of our baby really well, went the extra mile. They opened up recently but the service was really professional and affordable. They had a first time offer as well. Try it!

Phil and Annie are amazing! Our westies loved being groomed by them and had such a great time they didn’t want to leave! We highly recommend Nest our dogs were so comfortable and happy when they typically hate going to the groomers and are very anxious but Luna and Leo cannot wait to go back to Nest! They also did such a great job with the groom. The studio was very clean and cozy! Overall very impressed and we will definitely be going back!

Such an amazing grooming studio- They treat all their furry clients with kindness and respect. As a dog owner, that is what reassures me when leaving my baby with groomers! So gentle and checks in on everything so I know shes in good hands. Highly recommend!!!

I brought my 16 year old dog here for the first time and was blown away by the experience. He’s usually anxious at grooming appointments but he was completely calm and comfortable here. The team was so gentle and patient with him, and he came out with the best haircut he’s ever had! Highly recommend!
My 10 year old dog went for her first grooming at nest and it is the best grooming she has ever had! Her dog walker even commented on how amazing she looked.

Anne and Phil are extremely kind, knowledgeable and welcoming. Their studio is very clean and calming. They gave my dog exactly the cut I was looking for. Happy they are in the neighborhood, will definitely be back again.

Best grooming studio ever!!! Milo is a toy poodle (teddy bear like) and he always looks wonderful after his grooming sessions! He also LOVES the studio, which really speaks to how well they treat him :) 10/10 recommend!

This was my first time bringing my little shihpooh, Nala for a haircut here and I can say that Nest did an absolutely amazing job. I’ve been to several other groomers across Toronto and I can say that this was the best grooming session she’s gotten. I would highly recommend coming here for your pet’s next grooming session. Thank you Phil and Annie, you guys are amazing!!

What a lovely experience! This was Maya’s first time.  They took time to listen to my preferences and to hear about her past experiences. They were both genuinely into her having a positive visit and I knew she would be in good hands. As I was leaving they spent time with her outside to let her settle first. The groom was exceptionally well done. Spa day from head to toe! We will definitely be back.

Nest is the best! My dog is nervous at the groomer and they really took the time to make sure she was settled and feeling comfortable. It’s awesome they have an outdoor space, too! Super happy with the results and the photo keepsake they sent me is absolutely adorable!

This place was a 10/10 experience! From the minute we arrived we were provided with a friendly and welcoming greeting! A thorough consultation was done and they genuinely took time to get to know Loki. Loki has never looked so good after a grooming appointment. They did exactly what I asked for and did amazing shaping on his ears! We will be regular customers for sure! Lovely family business that deserves all the love and support!

We took our dog Otto to Nest Studio for grooming and we couldn’t be happier with the results! The team is incredibly dedicated, and it’s clear how much love and respect they have for dogs. Otto looked amazing and was so happy after his appointment. We absolutely recommend Nest and will definitely be coming back.
Excellent service! My dog was well cared for and well-groomed. Phil and Annie took the time to speak to me and ask questions about my dog. I will definitely bring her back.

Today was our first visit to Nest and we only have great things to say! The atmosphere is so calming and beautiful we loved it as soon as we stepped inside. Annie & Phil are the sweetest most gentle knowledgeable and caring people I ever seen in the grooming industry. They truly take the time to get to know your dog. The cut is the best haircut our dog has ever had, she came out looking amazing!!! Truly thankful to have found this new grooming spot! ♥️

Thank you 🙏
We had a wonderful experience, Ace was a very happy and playful puppy at the the of the grooming session. We loved how the grooming turned out as well! Highly recommend!
They took really good care of my dog Casper. Very good experience 😊 …
Excellent customer service

Phil and Annie treated my golden retriever, Ellie, like absolute royalty. From the moment we walked into nest’s calm, wellness-first space, Ellie couldn’t get enough of Phil and Annie. Their certified approach shows—Ellie’s coat is gleaming, her paws and ears are spotless, and the trim is flawless. Most importantly, Phil’s gentle manner kept the whole session stress-free. If you want skilled groomers who love your dog as much as you do, nest is the place. Ellie left looking fantastic and clearly smitten with Phil. Highly recommend!

Such a wonderful grooming service! The facility is clean, warm, and modern, and they really did an amazing job grooming my big boy.

The pricing is above what we normally pay, but they were upfront with this and we hope to be back again soon!

Amazing service! I asked for an Asian teddy bear cut for Kobe and they absolutely nailed it! They took the time during our consultation to really understand what I was looking for, and the end result was exactly what I had in mind. Kobe came out looking so stinking cute. 100% coming back. Thank you🥰 …

My 7-month-old puppy Cash had the best grooming experience at Nest! 🐾

They didn’t just rush into grooming — they took the time to play with him and let him get comfortable first, which I really appreciated. We had a consultation before they started to make sure they knew exactly what I wanted for his haircut, and they delivered it perfectly!

The space is so thoughtful — they even have an outdoor play area where dogs can take a break if needed. Cash came home looking adorable, smelling amazing, and most importantly, happy and relaxed. I’ll definitely be bringing him back!
Staff was amazing and so patient. My dog loved it here!

It’s rare to find a grooming place that feels this calming and aesthetic and I’ve been to mannnny in the area. Lucky’s usually a nervous wreck (especially for nail trims) but I think the fact that they have the relaxing consultation session genuinely makes a difference. He was way more relaxed the second visit. Just glad there’s finally a spot in the neighborhood that makes my dog feel good while getting groomed 😭

As a first-time pet parent with a 10-week-old puppy, I was really nervous about finding the right groomer, especially someone who could make my pup’s very first grooming experience positive and stress-free. And I’m SO glad I found Nest Grooming Studio!

The space itself is clean, bright, and super welcoming, which immediately put both me and my puppy at ease. But what really stood out was Philip, the groomer. He is incredibly knowledgeable, gentle, and genuinely passionate about what he does. It honestly felt like he cared for my puppy as if he were his own.

Philip took the time to understand my dog’s sensitivities, fears, and triggers before even starting. He didn’t rush anything, he slowly introduced my pup to the grooming tools, helped him get used to the sounds and sensations, and kept him calm and comfortable the entire time. The patience and care he showed made all the difference.

I couldn’t have asked for a better first grooming experience for my puppy. He came out looking fresh and adorable, and was so relaxed that he slept like a baby on the way home. I’m beyond happy with the whole experience and so grateful we found Nest Grooming Studio.
